title: Reminder data only through reminder_cli.py
context: The WebUI must show and change reminders, but a Python CLI with its own file lock owns the store and the versioned due contract.
decision: Add a runner + contract parser + routes that call reminder_cli.py for every read and write; explicit state per answer; no TypeScript store access.
consequences: Two-repo contract to keep pinned; one uv spawn per project per read; refusal text, command text and links are untrusted and inert.
rationale: A native reader would duplicate the due merge of reminders and triage parks and drift from the Python lock and contract.
rejected: Native TS read of reminders.jsonl; doing nothing server-side.
